instructions: Review against ITK project standards only. Documentation/AI/rule-tiers.md defines two tiers: project standards bind every contributor; sections and rows labeled 'Agent default' bind AI agents only. Do not report a violation of an agent default (numeric prose caps, word lists, first-person bans, draft-PR or self-audit steps). When text also misses the project standard behind it, cite that standard instead.

files.description: Which ITK rules reviewers may cite (project standards) and which bind AI agents only (agent defaults)
